projects.name: #YariFeeds250k
projects.summary: Rice, grains, beans, maize and sugar to 250,000 households in every one of Zamfara's 147 wards during Ramadan 2024, regardless of political affiliation.
projects.detail: Flagged off in Talata Mafara on 11 March 2024 with a distribution committee chaired by Hon. Liman. The stories of the families it reached were told in the documentary Hope Amidst Hunger, broadcast on Arise Television on 12 May 2024.

projects.name: Gummi flood recovery
projects.summary: After the 2024 floods took more than 2,000 homes in Gummi, fifteen trucks of relief supplies arrived first, then blocks, cement, builders and roofing until families had homes again.
facts: Committee set up with the Emir of Gummi
projects.detail: Support came step by step: mattresses and blankets, then building materials and money to pay builders, then roofing to finish each house. The rebuilding committee was directed to use modern, durable materials so the tragedy would not repeat.

projects.name: Bardoki Bridge
projects.summary: A promise to the people of Bardoki in Gummi Local Government, kept in August 2024. Around 2,500 people cross it every day to reach markets, schools and clinics.
projects.detail: Before the bridge, Bardoki was cut off from essential goods, services and opportunity. The bridge lowers transport costs, shortens travel time and keeps trade moving across the community.

projects.name: AA Yari Scholarship
projects.summary: More than 2,000 students across Zamfara are in school on the scholarship, most of whom have never met the man behind it.
projects.detail: Bushra lost her father young and had almost given up on school; today she is at the Federal University, Gusau. Hussaini is training to be a nurse so his community always has someone to run to.

projects.name: Free eye care
projects.summary: Free eye treatment for 1,000 people in Zamfara West, run by the constituency office with Visions Savers Eye Care Center.
projects.detail: Launched in November 2023 for vulnerable groups who would otherwise go without treatment, with comprehensive options to restore and preserve sight.

projects.name: ICT facility, College of Education Bakura
projects.summary: A full ICT laboratory so that the practical seventy percent of coursework is done on real equipment rather than on paper.

projects.name: Fertilizer support
projects.summary: Fertilizer for farmers across Zamfara as prices put a strong harvest out of reach.
projects.detail: Alhaji Umaru Fuloti has farmed for 66 years. The support gave him, and many others, another chance at a stronger harvest.

projects.name: Eid-el-Maulud distribution
projects.summary: Rice, maize and cattle to heads of households, widows and vulnerable groups across all 14 local governments in September 2023.

projects.name: Tudun Biri relief
projects.summary: With the Northern Senators Forum, a ₦58 million donation to the families affected by the airstrike in Tudun Biri, Kaduna State.

projects.name: Roads, bridges and erosion control
projects.summary: Personally funded works across Zamfara, separate from constituency projects, connecting communities and supporting local trade.

bio.lead: Abdulaziz Abubakar Yari is the Senator representing Zamfara West in the 10th Senate, the former two-term Governor of Zamfara State, and, since August 2026, Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council. He holds the traditional title Marafan Sokoto.
paragraphs: He was born and raised in Talata Mafara, Zamfara State, which he still calls home. His late father, Alhaji Abubakar Yari, remains his greatest inspiration: Baba's teachings, lessons and faith shaped the person he is today.

As Governor he welcomed Asiwaju Bola Ahmed Tinubu to Zamfara to commission township roads built by his administration, an early sign of a shared belief that infrastructure connects communities and drives growth.
In the Senate he chairs the Committee on Water Resources and sits on the joint committees on Water Resources and Sanitation and on Interior. He is a member of the Northern Senators Forum.
Outside the chamber his work in Zamfara runs through food distribution, disaster relief, scholarships, health outreach and infrastructure funded personally and through the constituency office.
family: The late Alhaji Abubakar Yari, laid to rest at Talata Mafara Central Cemetery.
Ahmad Yari, a member of the governing council of the City Boy Movement.
